# Address Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AddressTenure`](gmeow-AddressTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AddressTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified, time-scoped fact that an agent held a contact point (e.g. an email address) over a particular interval.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:AddressTenure`](gmeow-AddressTenure.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record that an agent held a contact point over a particular interval — the way a retired email or number is carried ([`validUntil`](../properties/gmeow-validUntil.md) in the past) rather than deleted (P10).

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for a current channel that needs no history (attach the contact point directly with [`gmeow:hasContactPoint`](../properties/gmeow-hasContactPoint.md)) and avoid deleting a lapsed channel — close its tenure instead.

### How to use

- Mint the situation, bind it with [`gmeow:addressHolder`](../properties/gmeow-addressHolder.md) and [`gmeow:tenuredContactPoint`](../properties/gmeow-tenuredContactPoint.md), and scope it on the temporal slice's time-scoped-relation interval; a past end-date retires the channel without erasing it.

### Examples

- ex:tenure a [`gmeow:AddressTenure`](gmeow-AddressTenure.md); [`gmeow:addressHolder`](../properties/gmeow-addressHolder.md) ex:lillith; [`gmeow:tenuredContactPoint`](../properties/gmeow-tenuredContactPoint.md) ex:oldEmail.
